verdict.rationale: No evidence in the pack of any Postman setting, policy, or documentation that lets users opt out of having their data used for AI model training; docs cover Agent Mode/Postbot features but not data-training controls, and community items only raise general data-privacy concerns (e.g., secrets uploaded to servers) without addressing AI training opt-out. Missing for 10: any documented AI-training opt-out/data-use setting, privacy policy language on model training, or admin control disabling AI data usage.
